title: Max Diceman
description:
Max Diceman is a 2D top-down roguelike RPG adventure game with a new mechanic - rolling 3D dice in battles and using those dice to change your powers at any time! 

Explore each randomly generated level to gather powerful dice, gear, and items on they way to uncover Max's story and defeat the horde's of enemies that stand in his way!

• Collect over 100 D4, D6, D8, D10, D12, or D20 dice with unique powers and effects
 

• Move dice to different slots to give you an edge in battle or activate magic abilities

• More than 100 rare tide-turning pieces of gear - weapons to arm and equipment for your head, body and feet

• Gather powerful items to restore health and magic or give you an advantage in battle

• Battle over 100 enemies and bosses that can have rare dice with special powers to obtain
description_short: Max Diceman is a 2D roguelike fantasy role-playing adventure where physics based 3D dice determine the outcome of each battle as rare dice and gear are collected to increase your power and chance to survive.
